note: Discovery leads only. Workers must independently read and verify each source before use.

tierA.useFor: scholarly reference articles and disputed-position framing

cautions: State premises, conclusions, scope, and counterexamples precisely; do not turn a philosophical view into an undisputed fact.
Present contested positions even-handedly and distinguish explanation from endorsement or personal advice.
Use ordinary hypothetical cases without diagnosing, prescribing, or advising on real high-stakes decisions.
Keep adjacent topics distinct: knowledge, justification, skepticism, metaphysics, identity, and ethics overlap but are not interchangeable.
Distribute question answer keys across A/B/C/D, include C and D, and verify each key from its saved options.
